party_a_statement: I vacated the apartment on 31 January and requested my security deposit of 30000 rupees back. B refuses to return it.
party_b_statement: Tenant left walls marked and kitchen tap leaking. Repair costs exceeded deposit.

evidence.description: Bank transfer receipt of security deposit
evidence.text: UPI Transfer of 30000 INR to Landlord on 2025-02-01. Ref: UPI998124.
Message dated 31 Jan: 'Handover complete. Photos attached.' Landlord replied: 'Keys received.'

evidence.description: Landlord handwritten notes of repair estimates
evidence.text: Painting and tap repairs: approx 30000 INR. No contractor bills.
